knowledge.en: Inflammaging is persistent low-grade age-related inflammation involving IL-1, IL-6, IL-8, IL-13, CRP, IFN-α/β and TNF; it occurs in many older adults and is implicated in multiple age-related diseases, functional decline and mortality.
knowledge.ru: Инфламмейджинг — стойкое слабовыраженное возрастное воспаление с участием IL-1, IL-6, IL-8, IL-13, CRP, IFN-α/β и TNF; оно встречается у многих пожилых и связывается с возрастными заболеваниями, снижением функций и смертностью.

attrs.mediators: IL-1; IL-6; IL-8; IL-13; CRP; IFN-α/β; TNF
attrs.associated_conditions: cardiovascular disease; cancer; chronic kidney disease; dementia; depression; sarcopenia; frailty
attrs.occurrence: majority of older adults, even without disease or risk factors

knowledge.modality: implicated, not established as a sufficient cause

knowledge.en: Evidence connecting diet and inflammation in older adults is scarce and inconsistent; adequate n-3 PUFA intake appears protective, and cited Italian/Scottish Mediterranean-diet studies followed participants for three/six years. Relations of individual food groups in MCI remain unclear.
knowledge.ru: Данные о питании и воспалении у пожилых малочисленны и неоднородны; достаточное потребление n-3 ПНЖК выглядит защитным. Цитируемые итальянское и шотландское исследования средиземноморской диеты длились три/шесть лет; связи отдельных продуктов при MCI неясны.

knowledge.en: Aging alters sleep architecture and increases insomnia, apnea and circadian/quality disturbances; cited studies disagree about sleep–inflammation associations, including a U-shaped objective-sleep relation in cognitively nonimpaired adults.
knowledge.ru: Старение меняет архитектуру сна и усиливает бессонницу, апноэ и циркадные/качественные нарушения; исследования связи сна с воспалением расходятся, включая U-образную связь объективного сна у когнитивно сохранных.
knowledge.modality: heterogeneous cited associations, including null findings

knowledge.en: Earlier work links leisure exercise to lower circulating inflammatory markers; a 12-week pilot in 30 CNI and 30 MCI participants and a review of MCI/dementia interventions reported reductions, but simple brisk-walking questions were not systematically studied.
knowledge.ru: Предыдущие работы связывают досуговую активность со снижением воспалительных маркеров; пилот на 12 недель с 30 CNI и 30 MCI и обзор вмешательств сообщали снижение, однако простой вопрос о быстрой ходьбе систематически не исследован.

knowledge.en: MCI involves early memory/other cognitive deficits with independence in most daily activities; cited prevalence is 15–20% after age 60 and annual progression to dementia 8–15%, motivating modifiable risk-factor research.
knowledge.ru: MCI включает ранние нарушения памяти/других функций при независимости в большинстве повседневных действий; цитируются распространённость 15–20% после 60 лет и годовой переход в деменцию 8–15%, что мотивирует поиск изменяемых факторов риска.

knowledge.en: Test cross-sectional relations of diet, objective/subjective sleep and mild physical activity with plasma TNF-α and IL-6, including whether MCI modifies the associations. The authors hypothesize independent lifestyle relations.

conditions: Cross-sectional Cretan Aging Cohort phase II; complete-data sample of 117 older adults (54 CNI, 63 MCI)

knowledge.en: The Cretan Aging Cohort was conducted in urban/rural Heraklion from March 2013 to June 2015 in two phases, with approval 13541 (20 November 2010) and informed consent.

knowledge.en: Screen consenting adults over 60 in primary care with trained-nurse interviews and Greek MMSE; use 23/24 because education is often ≤6 years, defining risk as <24 and nonrisk as ≥24.

knowledge.en: Phase I retained 3140 participants: 57% women, age 73.7±7.8 years (60–100), education 5.8±3.3 years (0–18), mostly rural.

knowledge.en: Invite the 636 people with MMSE <24 for phase II; 344 consented and were comparable on age, sex and BMI. Use extensive clinical/neuropsychological assessment and consensus by ≥2 clinicians under modified Petersen/IWG-1 criteria, excluding deficits explained by significant mood/anxiety disorder.

knowledge.en: Operational MCI requires age/education-adjusted z<−1.5 on at least two tests in a memory, language or attention/executive domain, with intact Lawton–Brody instrumental daily activities.

knowledge.en: Use ANOVA/chi-square group checks; partial correlations control MCI and select p<0.1 predictors. Regress TNF-α/IL-6 after age, sex, BMI and MCI, with age/sex/BMI in strata; use model p<.008, coefficient p<.017/.025 and G*Power minimum ΔR² .095 at 80% power.

knowledge.modality: may; author interpretation, not causal proof

attrs.background_comparison: Cretans consume up to three times as many vegetables as other European populations (cited)
attrs.prior_literature: younger studies support diet associations; older-men CRP study null; Mediterranean diet cognition benefits cited

knowledge.en: Discussion claims long sleep >450 min is significant in MCI after multiplicity correction, although Results/Table 5 report nonsignificant MCI coefficients. Preserve this discussion claim without resolving the discrepancy.

knowledge.modality: as asserted in Discussion; conflicts with reported Results

knowledge.en: Long sleep may mark inflammation rather than cause it: cited IL-1β/TNF sleep regulation, IL-1β/IL-6-induced sleepiness and apnea/narcolepsy findings support bidirectional possibilities; long sleep is also associated with cardiovascular risk, decline and mortality.

attrs.background: sleep deprivation may increase markers, whereas inflammation may lengthen sleep; cited etanercept pilot reduced daytime sleepiness in apnea

knowledge.en: Brisk walking ≥10 minutes on ≥3 days might help limit inflammation even in MCI, but this is an interpretation of observational associations and earlier exercise studies, not an intervention demonstrated by this study.

conditions: Cross-sectional Cretan Aging Cohort phase II; complete-data sample of 117 older adults (54 CNI, 63 MCI)

knowledge.en: Study strengths include simultaneous lifestyle assessment, Cretan diet context and practical primary-care questions plus actigraphy, with significant/borderline group findings as interpreted by the authors.
knowledge.ru: Сильные стороны: совместная оценка образа жизни, критское питание, простые вопросы первичной помощи и актиграфия; значимые/пограничные подгрупповые результаты — оценка авторов.

knowledge.en: Three-day actigraphy is shorter than the suggested 1–2 weeks; sleep/apnea/activity self-report and unmodeled medication/comorbidity limit inference, and the cross-sectional design cannot establish causality.
knowledge.ru: Трёхдневная актиграфия короче рекомендованных 1–2 недель; самоотчёт сна/апноэ/активности и неучтённые лекарства/коморбидность ограничивают выводы, поперечный дизайн не устанавливает причинность.

attrs.unmodeled: medication and comorbidity beyond reported models

knowledge.en: Validate lifestyle findings in larger prospective/interventional studies before claiming that vegetable-rich active lifestyles reduce morbidity, mortality or cognitive decline. The present study leaves these questions unresolved.

conditions: Cross-sectional Cretan Aging Cohort phase II; complete-data sample of 117 older adults (54 CNI, 63 MCI)

knowledge.en: The authors suggest vegetables, active living and caution with sleep-prolonging sedatives/psychotropics as practical primary-care implications; these are proposed recommendations rather than tested treatment effects.
